architecture_fit_summary: Desired topology: customer VPC with private subnets + transit gateway; Redwood Private runtime deployed in dedicated subnet via cross-account role
Inbound: no inbound public endpoints; PrivateLink or interface endpoints for control plane where required; customer prefers mutual TLS
Outbound: egress via customer-managed NAT + VPC endpoints to S3 and KMS; strict egress allowlist to Redwood control-plane endpoints restricted to specific IP ranges
KMS integration: BYOK required; option A = AWS KMS cross-account key with grants to Redwood service principal; option B = HSM-backed KMS (FIPS) for highest assurance
Audit logging: stream inference access logs to customer S3 bucket + CloudWatch -> SIEM; retention policy 7 years; the logs must include request ids, model version, token counts
Regions: primary us-east-1; DR in us-west-2. Data residency: all inference payloads must remain in selected region(s) and not be replicated outside US
Routing/fallback: policy to route to smaller quantized model variant in case of capacity constraints; can be scoped per-tenant
Network controls: security groups locked to specific subnets, strict IAM fine-grained roles for model rollout and admin ops
